note: Registry of recommended push-to-comply template repositories. `ptcomply init` reads this file from the main branch of pmarkert/push-to-comply. Anyone can build a compatible template repository (any git repo with controls/, standards/, and context/ directories) and use it via `ptcomply init <dir> --template <repo>`; open a pull request to list a public template here.

templates.name: soc2-starter
templates.description: SOC 2 starter program: policies, narratives, and recurring procedures mapped to the 2017 Trust Services Criteria (paraphrased summaries).

templates.name: evidence
templates.description: Engagement-scoped evidence repository: auditor requests, inbox triage, curated evidence linked to criteria via `supports`, observations, runbooks, and agent skills.
